texto.es: A cualquier hora del día o de la noche. Nos cuentas qué pasa y te orientamos de inmediato.
texto.en: Any time, day or night. Tell us what is going on and we will point you in the right direction right away.

texto.es: Revisamos el problema real antes de hablar de precio, para que sepas exactamente qué hace falta.
texto.en: We check the real problem before talking price, so you know exactly what is needed.

texto.es: Te damos un precio claro antes de empezar, sin cargos escondidos ni sorpresas a mitad de trabajo.
texto.en: We give you a clear price before starting, no hidden charges, no mid-job surprises.

texto.es: Reparamos, instalamos o actualizamos con el mismo cuidado que ves en nuestras fotos, y dejamos todo probado y funcionando.
texto.en: We repair, install or upgrade with the same care you see in our photos, and leave everything tested and working.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el alcance real del problema. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the real scope of the problem. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Diagnóstico y reparación de tomacorrientes, interruptores, cortos y circuitos que fallan, disponible las 24 horas.
texto.en: Diagnosis and repair of outlets, switches, shorts and failing circuits, available around the clock.

texto.es: Reemplazo e instalación de paneles eléctricos para que tu casa soporte lo que hoy se le conecta, hecho para pasar inspección.
texto.en: Electrical panel replacement and installation so your home handles everything you plug in today, built to pass inspection.

texto.es: Instalación segura de estaciones de carga para vehículos eléctricos en tu garaje o entrada.
texto.en: Safe installation of EV charging stations in your garage or driveway.

texto.es: Instalación de luces empotradas, lámparas y accesorios, con poco o ningún daño a paredes y techo.
texto.en: Installation of recessed lights, fixtures and accessories, with little to no damage to walls and ceiling.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos igual: atendemos emergencias eléctricas a cualquier hora.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us anyway: we handle electrical emergencies any time of day.

items.quote: I had used Maxwell Electric for an electrical issue I had at my home and found this company to be fast, efficient and fairly priced. He was professional and took the time to go over the job in detail, so I wouldn't be left wondering. I would highly recommend this company time and time again!! A very pleasant experience indeed.

I am very impressed with Maxwell Electric. They were able to fit me in on the same day. The electrician was knowledgeable and personable. The price was beyond reasonable. I will definitely be calling them back if I have any further electrical needs.
Ryan diagnosed a problem for me that 2 other licensed electricians could not figure out. He's very methodical and is easy to deal with, highly recommend.
